page: Setup · Dose administration aids · Step 4 of 4 · Service 1 of 17 · Question 9 of 14
text:
Ask for the filing location on the same screen
- Written consent — When the proprietor selects Obtained and kept on file, show Where are signed consent forms kept? directly below.
- Collection and delivery records — Keep the existing location question. If both apply, let the proprietor indicate whether they use the same location or separate locations.
- Filing details — When a storage option is selected, let the proprietor add the software name, folder or filing location. Use that detail in the relevant part of the generated procedure.
Apply this pattern where the filing location matters, and
